dashboard_source_owner.name: dashboard_source_owner
dashboard_source_owner.value: ("dashboards"."source" = 'file' AND "dashboards"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("dashboards"."source" = 'inline' AND "dashboards"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

dashboard_source_content.name: dashboard_source_content
dashboard_source_content.value: ("dashboards"."source" = 'inline' AND "dashboards"."html" IS NOT NULL AND "dashboards"."path" IS NULL) OR ("dashboards"."source" = 'file' AND "dashboards"."html" IS NULL AND "dashboards"."path" IS NOT NULL)

merchant_category_origin_owner.name: merchant_category_origin_owner
merchant_category_origin_owner.value: ("merchant_category"."origin" = 'rule' AND "merchant_category"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("merchant_category"."origin" = 'history' AND "merchant_category"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

subcategory_requires_category.name: subcategory_requires_category
subcategory_requires_category.value: "transactions"."subcategory_id" IS NULL OR "transactions"."category_id" IS NOT NULL
